title: Dipping in Sauce, or Eating Standing Up?
synopsis: Chinese has many homophones, and Little Wang accidentally gets mixed up in front of his girlfriend’s family.

fullText.simplified:
蘸着吃还是站着吃

    小王是南方人，大学毕业后在北方的一个城市找了一份工作，一年后，又找了个北方的女朋友。他和女朋友相处得特别好，因为女朋友的家就在小王工作的城市，所以小王打算去女友家见见她的父母。
    国庆节放假的时候，女友带他回了家。女友的妈妈特别喜欢小王，一见到小王就很热情，拉着他的手跟他聊东聊西。女友的妈妈说：“小王，咱中午包饺子吃。我听说你们南方跟我们北方不一样，我们蘸着吃，你们呢？”小王因为紧张，理解错了女友妈妈的意思，说了句：“阿姨，我们坐着吃。”女友妈妈听完哈哈大笑，边笑边说小王可爱。
    你看明白了吗？小王女友妈妈的意思是：北方人吃饺子喜欢蘸着醋吃，问南方人吃饺子怎么吃？但是小王以为是站起来吃的意思，闹了一个大笑话。
fullText.traditional:
蘸著吃還是站著吃

    小王是南方人，大學畢業後在北方的一個城市找了一份工作，一年後，又找了個北方的女朋友。他和女朋友相處得特別好，因為女朋友的家就在小王工作的城市，所以小王打算去女友家見見她的父母。
    國慶節放假的時候，女友帶他回了家。女友的媽媽特別喜歡小王，一見到小王就很熱情，拉著他的手跟他聊東聊西。女友的媽媽說：“小王，咱中午包餃子吃。我聽說你們南方跟我們北方不一樣，我們蘸著吃，你們呢？”小王因為緊張，理解錯了女友媽媽的意思，說了句：“阿姨，我們坐著吃。”女友媽媽聽完哈哈大笑，邊笑邊說小王可愛。
    你看明白了嗎？小王女友媽媽的意思是：北方人吃餃子喜歡蘸著醋吃，問南方人吃餃子怎麼吃？但是小王以為是站起來吃的意思，鬧了一個大笑話。

raw.synopsis: Chinese has many homophones, and Little Wang accidentally gets mixed up in front of his girlfriend’s family.
sentence_translations: Dipping in Sauce, or Eating Standing Up?
Little Wang is from southern China. After graduating from college, he found a job in a northern Chinese city.
A year later, he also found a girlfriend from northern China. They have a very good relationship.
Because his girlfriend’s family lives in the very city he works in, ..
.. Little Wang decided to go to his girlfriend’s home to meet her parents.
During the National Day holiday, his girlfriend brought him home.
His girlfriend’s mom liked him a lot. When she met Little Wang, right away she was very warm to him.
She held his hands and started chatting away.
His girlfriend’s mom said, “Little Wang, let’s make dumplings for lunch.
I hear that you southerners are different from us northerners. We like to eat our dumplings with dip. What about you?”
Because Little Wang was nervous, he misunderstood his girlfriend’s mom’s meaning.
He replied, “Auntie, we eat them sitting down.”
After hearing this, his girlfriend’s mom burst out in laughter. As she laughed, she said how endearing Little Wang was.
Little Wang’s girlfriend’s mom meant that northerners like to eat dumplings dipped in vinegar, ..
.. and was asking how southerners liked their dumplings.
But Little Wang thought that she meant eating while standing up, and this became a big joke.
